content: Hessafe guye, Goday Iyyasuko haysada yaagis;
“Taani Muse baggara kiitidaysada, ‘Asay baqatidi attiya katamata dummayana mela’ Isra7eele asaas oda.
Oonika qoponnanne eronna ase wodhiko, yaa baqatidi gukida suuthaa gisho suuthi zaaranaw koya uraape attana.
Ase wodhidaysi he katamatape issuwako baqatidi bidi, katamaa pengen eqidi, hanidaba ubbaa he katamaa cimatas odo. Hessafe guye, enti banta katamaa efidi, I daana bessi immiko entara yan de7o.
Suuthaa gisho suuthi zaaranaw koya uray iya kaallidi yiiko, I ba ishaa eridi, qohanaw koyidi wodhiboonna gisho he katamaa cimati iya aathidi immofo.
Shango sinthan shiiqidi, pirdetana gakanawunne he wode de7iya kahine halaqay hayqana gakanaw he kataman de7o. Hessafe guye, baqatidi keyida katamaa guye simmidi ba soo gelo” yaagis.
Yaatin Isra7eele asay derey dariya Niftaalemen Galilan de7iya Qaadesa, derey dariya Efreeman de7iya Seekemanne derey dariya Yihudan de7iya Qiriyaat-Arba woyko Kebroona dummayidosona.

Yordaanose shaafape hefinthan, Iyaarkofe doloha baggan dhoqan, mela biittan, Robeela, kochata biittan de7iya Boosora, Gaade kochata biittan, Galadan de7iya Ramotanne Minaase kochata biittan, Baasanen de7iya Goolana dummayidosona.

Isra7eele asaynne enta giddon de7iya betanchoti baqatidi attana mela dummatida katamati haysata. Oonika eronna de7ishe ase wodhiko, shango sinthan pirdetonna de7ishe, hayqonna attanaw ha katamatape issuwako baqatanaw danda7ees.
